findings.element: How we get the data › Accounting › Import method (non-clearing account, e.g. Stripe fees / Business Checking)
findings.finding: For a non-clearing account the prototype forces the Accounting side to 'Manual' and requires a 'General ledger export from QuickBooks Online' upload. Production keeps the Accounting Import method at Automated with both Automated and Manual available.
findings.user_impact: Users reconciling any non-clearing account get an extra QuickBooks upload that production retrieves automatically, so the prototype misrepresents the manual path's effort.
findings.suggested_fix: For non-clearing accounts, force only the Integration side to Manual. Leave the Accounting Import method on 'Automated (recommended)' with 'Manual' selectable and no QuickBooks upload by default.

evidence.quote: COMBO 0 MENU: Automated | Recommended | Synder automatically retrieves, maps, and matches the necessary files for you. | Manual | Upload your files and set up mapping rules yourself.
evidence.source: reference/cap4.log · 'Stripe fees (combos 4)' and 'Checking (combos 4)' blocks, COMBO 0 = Accounting Import method (the page text still shows 'Automated'); reference.json screen.manual_account

findings.element: What to reconcile › Integration select options
findings.finding: Production's 'No integration — reconcile a GL account' option, which lists all 174 GL accounts ungrouped in Manual mode, is missing. The prototype offers only the three connections ('mzkt.by (Stripe)', 'Great payments for every one (PayPal)', 'My store (Shopify)').
findings.user_impact: The prototype silently drops a production capability, and the spec's 'No integration / any GL account: Manual only' mode, so this path cannot be shown or tested.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a 'No integration — reconcile a GL account' option to the Integration select. It should list all GL accounts ungrouped and force Manual with the required uploads.

evidence.quote: No integration — reconcile a GL account
evidence.source: reference/02-integration-open.txt · Integration menu options; reference/cap3.log '===== No integration' COMBO 2 (174 accounts); spec modes 'No integration / any GL account: Manual only'

findings.element: Matching rules modal (link in How we get the data)
findings.finding: The modal lists Date as a match key: 'Default profile — Primary ID, Amount, Date' and 'Fuzzy amount ±0.01 · same calendar day'. The spec says matching is a 3-pass ID cascade on ID + amount and never compares dates.
findings.user_impact: The prototype tells users matches depend on transaction dates, so reviewers are shown matching logic the product does not use.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the modal to describe the ID + amount cascade (3 passes) and remove the Date key and the 'same calendar day' rule.

evidence.quote: Matching is a 3-pass ID cascade on ID + amount. Dates are never compared when matching.
evidence.source: context.md Domain facts (SET spec Confluence 3701506049). Production's 'matching rules' link target was not captured, so there is no production text to compare

findings.finding: A custom range ending today (Sep 1–25) is accepted and starts a run. The date inputs have empty min/max, so today can be selected, against the spec rule.
findings.user_impact: The prototype demonstrates a run the spec forbids, so the date-validation behaviour it shows does not match the product rule.
findings.suggested_fix: Cap the custom end date at yesterday (input max = today − 1). When a range includes today, show an inline error and do not start the run.

evidence.source: context.md Domain facts (SET spec Confluence 3701506049); Theme 4 PARTIAL. Production's handling of today/future dates was not captured

findings.element: How we get the data › Import method selects (Accounting and Integration)
findings.finding: Production's Import method options each carry a one-line description (Automated, Assisted, Manual). The prototype's native selects show bare labels ('Automated (recommended)', 'Assisted', 'Manual') and no explanation anywhere.
findings.user_impact: Without production's per-option explanation, the prototype gives users no way to tell Assisted from Manual.
findings.suggested_fix: Add production's descriptions to each Import method option, or as helper text under the select for the chosen method.
